title: [Snyk] SNYK-PYTHON-DSPY-13832222 in dspy@2.5.7
description:
## Improper Isolation or Compartmentalization

**Severity:** high
**Package:** dspy@2.5.7
**File:** `pyproject.toml`

**CVSS Score:** 8.2  
**Exploit Maturity:** proof-of-concept  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 731/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2025-12695](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-12695)

**Fix:** Upgrade `dspy` to version 3.1.2 or later.

### Details
## Overview
[dspy](https://pypi.org/project/dspy) is a DSPy

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Improper Isolation or Compartmentalization via the `PythonInterpreter` class. An attacker can access arbitrary files by executing untrusted code within the sandbox.
## Remediation
Upgrade `dspy` to version 3.1.2 or higher.
## References
- [GitHub Commit](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/commit/f32edbdbc2a001aed41152912c2dafebfd196365)
- [Vulnerable Code](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy/blob/5e72f7bbb609f28abe7fa2490812b5ed5dd8d8a6/dspy/primitives/python_interpreter.py#L13)


### Reference
- [Snyk advisory](https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PYTHON-DSPY-13832222)
